description:
I’m samiksha, an engineering admission and career counsellor dedicated to helping students choose the right path after entrance exams.
I assist with college and branch selection across Maharashtra, keeping cutoffs and long-term scope in mind.
My guidance covers CAP rounds, cutoff analysis, and careful option filling to avoid common mistakes.
I focus on clear explanations, honest advice, and practical decision-making.
My goal is to make the admission process simpler and less stressful for students and parents.
